Found 6 items in registries @delego:

Showing items 1-6 of 6:

- delego-theme (registry:theme) - Delego design tokens mapped onto shadcn variables (OKLCH, light + dark). Electric-indigo primary, signal-mint accent, and the protocol decision palette (allow / needs_approval / deny). Pairs Inter (sans) + JetBrains Mono (mono); load the fonts in your app — see the registry README. [@delego] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- button (registry:ui) - Delego button — primary (indigo glow), secondary, ghost, outline, link, plus protocol-semantic allow/deny actions. [@delego] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- status-badge (registry:ui) - Mono pill with leading icon + status color. Variants: allow, approval, deny, indigo (principal/audit), neutral. [@delego] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- decision-pill (registry:ui) - The signature Delego element: renders a Decision outcome (allow / needs_approval / deny) with its canonical icon, mono label, and color. [@delego] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- signed-receipt (registry:ui) - The ownable audit visual — one hash-chained, Ed25519-signed ledger record, with the signal bar, seal, and mono kv grid. [@delego] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- field (registry:ui) - Labeled input with optional leading icon and mono hint, lit by the indigo focus halo. Drop-in over a native input. [@delego] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
